newsitem.title: UK: Horlick set to join Societe Generale - FT.
newsitem.headline: Horlick set to join Societe Generale - FT.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, former star fund manager at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, is poised to join the French bank Societe Generale, the Financial Times said on Wednesday.
The newspaper said Horlick was due to set up a new team at Societe Generale with John Richards, formerly one of Mercury Asset Management Group Plc's most senior fund managers.
It said Richards resigned on Tuesday after 14 years at MAM -- the UK's leading fund management group.
Horlick resigned earlier this year from Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, owned by Deutsche Bank AG, after allegations that she had been trying to lure a team of fund managers to a competitor.
The newspaper said Societe Generale confirmed Richards would be joining within six months.
The bank said contract negotiations with Horlock had not been concluded yet but added that her chances of joining were "better than one in two".
Horlick and Richards worked together at MAM.
